title: naive JOIN：order amountが明細数だけ複製
relation_sql: SELECT o.order_id,o.customer_id,o.amount,CASE WHEN o.customer_id IS NULL THEN 'NULL_KEY' WHEN c.customer_id IS NULL THEN 'UNKNOWN_KEY' ELSE c.region END AS bucket,CAST(l.line_id AS TEXT) AS line_refs FROM orders o JOIN lines l ON l.order_id=o.order_id LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id ORDER BY o.order_id,l.line_id
metric_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS input_rows,COUNT(o.amount) AS known_rows,COUNT(*)-COUNT(o.amount) AS missing_rows,SUM(o.amount) AS amount_sum,TOTAL(o.amount) AS amount_total FROM orders o JOIN lines l ON l.order_id=o.order_id

title: lineをorder粒度へ先に集約
relation_sql: WITH per_order AS (SELECT order_id,GROUP_CONCAT(line_id) AS line_refs FROM (SELECT line_id,order_id FROM lines ORDER BY line_id) GROUP BY order_id) SELECT o.order_id,o.customer_id,o.amount,CASE WHEN o.customer_id IS NULL THEN 'NULL_KEY' WHEN c.customer_id IS NULL THEN 'UNKNOWN_KEY' ELSE c.region END AS bucket,p.line_refs FROM orders o JOIN per_order p ON p.order_id=o.order_id LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id ORDER BY o.order_id
metric_sql: WITH per_order AS (SELECT order_id,COUNT(*) AS line_count FROM lines GROUP BY order_id) SELECT COUNT(*) AS input_rows,COUNT(o.amount) AS known_rows,COUNT(*)-COUNT(o.amount) AS missing_rows,SUM(o.amount) AS amount_sum,TOTAL(o.amount) AS amount_total FROM orders o JOIN per_order p ON p.order_id=o.order_id

title: EXISTS：lineの有無だけを調べる
relation_sql: SELECT o.order_id,o.customer_id,o.amount,CASE WHEN o.customer_id IS NULL THEN 'NULL_KEY' WHEN c.customer_id IS NULL THEN 'UNKNOWN_KEY' ELSE c.region END AS bucket,(SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(line_id) FROM (SELECT line_id FROM lines WHERE order_id=o.order_id ORDER BY line_id)) AS line_refs FROM orders o LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM lines l WHERE l.order_id=o.order_id) ORDER BY o.order_id
metric_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS input_rows,COUNT(amount) AS known_rows,COUNT(*)-COUNT(amount) AS missing_rows,SUM(amount) AS amount_sum,TOTAL(amount) AS amount_total FROM orders o WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM lines l WHERE l.order_id=o.order_id)

title: SUM(DISTINCT amount)：同額の別orderを失う
grain: one row per line_id; DISTINCT applies to amount value, not order_id
relation_sql: SELECT o.order_id,o.customer_id,o.amount,CASE WHEN o.customer_id IS NULL THEN 'NULL_KEY' WHEN c.customer_id IS NULL THEN 'UNKNOWN_KEY' ELSE c.region END AS bucket,CAST(l.line_id AS TEXT) AS line_refs FROM orders o JOIN lines l ON l.order_id=o.order_id LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id ORDER BY o.order_id,l.line_id
metric_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS input_rows,COUNT(o.amount) AS known_rows,COUNT(*)-COUNT(o.amount) AS missing_rows,SUM(DISTINCT o.amount) AS amount_sum,TOTAL(DISTINCT o.amount) AS amount_total FROM orders o JOIN lines l ON l.order_id=o.order_id

title: LEFT dimension：未知とNULLを残してbucket集計
grain: one row per order_id -> one row per bucket
relation_sql: SELECT o.order_id,o.customer_id,o.amount,CASE WHEN o.customer_id IS NULL THEN 'NULL_KEY' WHEN c.customer_id IS NULL THEN 'UNKNOWN_KEY' ELSE c.region END AS bucket,(SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(line_id) FROM (SELECT line_id FROM lines WHERE order_id=o.order_id ORDER BY line_id)) AS line_refs FROM orders o LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM lines l WHERE l.order_id=o.order_id) ORDER BY o.order_id
metric_sql: WITH eligible AS (SELECT o.amount,CASE WHEN o.customer_id IS NULL THEN 'NULL_KEY' WHEN c.customer_id IS NULL THEN 'UNKNOWN_KEY' ELSE c.region END AS bucket FROM orders o LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM lines l WHERE l.order_id=o.order_id)) SELECT bucket,COUNT(*) AS input_rows,COUNT(amount) AS known_rows,COUNT(*)-COUNT(amount) AS missing_rows,SUM(amount) AS amount_sum,TOTAL(amount) AS amount_total FROM eligible GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY bucket

title: INNER dimension：未知とNULLのorderが消える
grain: one row per matched order_id -> one row per bucket
relation_sql: SELECT o.order_id,o.customer_id,o.amount,c.region AS bucket,(SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(line_id) FROM (SELECT line_id FROM lines WHERE order_id=o.order_id ORDER BY line_id)) AS line_refs FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM lines l WHERE l.order_id=o.order_id) ORDER BY o.order_id
metric_sql: SELECT c.region AS bucket,COUNT(*) AS input_rows,COUNT(o.amount) AS known_rows,COUNT(*)-COUNT(o.amount) AS missing_rows,SUM(o.amount) AS amount_sum,TOTAL(o.amount) AS amount_total FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM lines l WHERE l.order_id=o.order_id) GROUP BY c.region ORDER BY c.region

title: amountが全部NULL：既知0とは違う
relation_sql: SELECT o.order_id,o.customer_id,o.amount,'NULL_KEY' AS bucket,CAST(l.line_id AS TEXT) AS line_refs FROM orders o JOIN lines l ON l.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.order_id=4 ORDER BY o.order_id
metric_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS input_rows,COUNT(amount) AS known_rows,COUNT(*)-COUNT(amount) AS missing_rows,SUM(amount) AS amount_sum,TOTAL(amount) AS amount_total FROM orders WHERE order_id=4

title: 対象orderなし：空集合
relation_sql: SELECT o.order_id,o.customer_id,o.amount,'NONE' AS bucket,CAST(l.line_id AS TEXT) AS line_refs FROM orders o JOIN lines l ON l.order_id=o.order_id WHERE o.order_id<0 ORDER BY o.order_id
metric_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS input_rows,COUNT(amount) AS known_rows,COUNT(*)-COUNT(amount) AS missing_rows,SUM(amount) AS amount_sum,TOTAL(amount) AS amount_total FROM orders WHERE order_id<0
